crons.comment: Incremental sync: each source resumes from its oldest day not read final (up to 35 days), spend for every platform first, then Salesforce since its last completed read, then Google click_view. Hourly needs a plan that allows it; the nightly entry below does not.
Nightly re-pull: 90 days of paid-media spend and conversions, 35 of GA4 and Search Console, upserted — so restatements land and any day the hourly run missed is read. 07:00 UTC is 3am Eastern.
